welcome.title: Welcome to GigBuddy
welcome.subtitle: Everything your band needs in one place: gigs, rehearsals, setlists and finances.
welcome.trialPitch: Pick what you're setting up and try Gold free for 30 days.
welcome.haveInvite: Joining an existing band? Redeem your invite code

trialOffer.addToTrial_one: Add to your trial · {{count}} day remaining
trialOffer.addToTrial_other: Add to your trial · {{count}} days remaining
trialOffer.remainderNote: Adding this is free and runs for the remainder of your current trial — it does not start a new trial period.

terms.mustAgree: Please agree to the terms to continue.

acceptTerms.title: Updated Terms & Conditions
acceptTerms.subtitle: We've updated our Terms & Conditions. Please review and accept them to continue.
acceptTerms.agree: I have read and agree to the Terms & Conditions

summary.title: Almost there
summary.trialNote: No payment details are needed to start. Your Gold trial runs until {{date, datetime}}; subscription choices and the exact future charge date are shown after it starts.
summary.addToTrialNote: This is added to your running trial and ends with it on {{date, datetime}}. No new trial period starts, and no payment details are needed.
summary.paymentNote: You'll choose your payment method on our payment provider's secure page. Your paid subscription starts once that payment is confirmed.
summary.freeNote: The free plan needs no payment details.
summary.confirmAddToTrial: Create workspace and add to trial

checkout.success: Your subscription is active. Have fun!
checkout.timeout: Your payment is still being processed. You can enter the app — your plan activates automatically once the payment is confirmed.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load the subscription plans. Please try again.
errors.onboardingDisabled: New tenant onboarding is currently disabled. You can still join an existing band with an invite code.
errors.bandCapNoPointer: You already own a band, so onboarding isn't needed. You can manage plans in Settings.
errors.bandCapReached: Your current subscription has reached its band limit. Upgrade your plan to add another band.
errors.bothTrialsRunning: Your trial already covers both band and artist workspaces, so there's nothing left to start here. You can create additional bands from your app.
errors.trialTierMissing: No trial plan is configured for this product yet. Please contact support.
errors.addToTrialFailed: Your workspace was created, but it couldn't be added to your trial. You can add it from Settings → Billing.
errors.logoUploadFailed: The logo could not be uploaded — you can add it later under Profile.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.claimFailed: We couldn't submit your band profile claim. You can try again from Settings.

band.title: Set up your band
band.nameRequired: Enter your band name to continue.
band.slugCaveat: If this name is taken, a number is added automatically (e.g. {{slug}}-2).
band.countryHelper: Where this band keeps its books. This sets the VAT rules, chart of accounts and reporting rules, and cannot be changed later.
band.resumeNote: Your band "{{name}}" was already created — we’ll pick up where you left off.

personal.title: Set up your artist workspace
personal.nameRequired: Enter your artist name to continue.
personal.slugCaveat: If this name is taken, a number is added automatically (e.g. {{slug}}-2).
personal.countryHelper: Where you keep your own books. This sets the VAT rules, chart of accounts and reporting rules, and cannot be changed later.
personal.resumeNote: Your workspace "{{name}}" was already created — we’ll pick up where you left off.

band.label: A band
band.help: A shared workspace for a group: agenda, roster, repertoire and the band’s books.

personal.label: My own artist workspace
personal.help: Your own agenda, contacts and books, as the musician. You can join bands later.

claimProfile.title: Already known as this band?
claimProfile.description: Musicians not yet on gigbuddy may already be tagging their events with your band. Claim that profile so it becomes yours. Optional — we verify it afterwards.
claimProfile.pendingReview: We'll review this claim after your workspace is created.
